record.paper: Polynomial bounds for chromatic number VII. Disjoint holes

dossier_meta.paper: Polynomial bounds for chromatic number VII. Disjoint holes
dossier_meta.statement_text: It might be true that every forest $H$ is good, i.e., the class of $H$-free graphs is polynomially $\chi$-bounded (strengthening the Gyárfás–Sumner conjecture from $\chi$-boundedness to polynomial $\chi$-boundedness).
dossier_meta.context_text: Say a forest $H$ is good if the class of $H$-free graphs is polynomially $\chi$-bounded. This has been proved only for a few simple kinds of tree and some of their disjoint unions; the polynomial strengthening of Gyárfás–Sumner is fully open.
